sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State
Counsel for Revisionist :- Veer Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
Called in revise.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgment and order 02.02.1993.

The Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate IIIrd, Bijnor vide order dated 09.03.1991 convicted revisionist under Section 7/16(1)(A) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954 (hereinafter referred to as ?Act, 1954?) and Rule 50 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules,
1955 (hereinafter referred to as ?Rules, 1955?) and sentenced him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- under Section 7/16 of Act, 1954 and fine of Rs. 200/- under Rule 50 of Rules, 1955.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate IIIrd, Bijnor
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereagainst, revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 37 of 1991 and Appellate Court while allowing appeal partly set aside the conviction and sentence under Rule 50 of 1955 Rules but confirmed the conviction and sentence awarded under Section 7/16 of Act, 1954.
Being aggrieved the revisionist preferred present revision.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
4. Dismissed.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
5. The accused, Matloob, is on bail.
His bail bonds and surety bonds are cancelled.
The Chief Judicial Magistrate concerned shall cause him to be arrested and lodged in jail to serve out the sentence passed against him.
The compliance shall be prepared within two months.
